blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY – The proposed New Northern Samar Airport has moved to the project preparation stage after the Department of Transportation (DOTr) opened bidding for consulting services for the feasibility study and other assessments needed for the proposed facility in Pambujan town. The procurement, opened Sept. 11, covers the feasibility study and master plan, environmental and social impact assessment, and land acquisition and resettlement action plan for the project. The proposed airport site is in Pambujan, about 37 kilometers east of Catarman, the provincial capital, where the current facility is located.
